units.source_text: 灼热的小石子上只落下我的孤影。

en.t: Only my solitary shadow fell on the scorching pebbles.

units.source_text: 应该说，金阁在那边，我在这边。

en.t: Rather, I should say that the Golden Pavilion was over there, and I was over here.

units.source_text: 自从我一睹这天的金阁，我就感到"我们"的关系已经发生了变化。

en.t: Ever since I caught sight of the Golden Pavilion that day, I felt that the relationship between "us" had already changed.
